svg.text: used jack (colour: input blue, output green, power orange, other purple)
unused jack (the tick points to the side the plug enters from)
plug head and its cable exit
plug points down into a hole
edge crossing: cables may go round the board edge here
dashed light: cable under the board
brown: DC power cable (P#, or P#.n for the legs of a daisy chain: one label per leg), thinner than the patch cables
dashed light brown: power cable under the board
ring: power cable through a hole
